phases: Write T1-T7 including T6b; confirm which are red and which are green-before, and report both
audit_history.append raises on invalid; read loses its inert try/except and documents that it does not validate
session_signature_timestamps yields ts only where present; counter untouched; false docstring guarantee replaced
Guard the K-window index in check_session_total against a short list, treating unanchorable as not-suppressed
validate_session_id as first statement of check_session_total
ci_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_audit_history_validation.py tests/test_session_id_path_safety.py tests/test_cycle_count_escalator.py tests/test_stall_walk.py tests/test_session_total_signature_count.py tests/test_provenance_iteration_scope.py -q
